provenance: PR #23 round 1 R1/R2. The initial TinBoker restyle kept the empty page within 390px but did not exercise a rendered trace target: 90 unbroken characters expanded the document to 665px. The light placeholder also mixed --dim at 82% with transparency, rendering at 3.61:1 against the paper-terminal input background. This browser case renders the actual stepEl output in both color schemes and measures document width plus the effective computed placeholder color.

triage.note: Narrow responsiveness and contrast must be checked in the populated UI, not inferred only from static container widths and opaque palette tokens.
